title.narrative: Strengthen national capacities on responsible AI, digital governance, incl. DT

description.narrative: UNESCO will strengthen the capacities of public institutions and relevant stakeholders in both Lebanon and Jordan to better understand, assess, and harness the opportunities of digital transformation and artificial intelligence (AI) in a responsible, inclusive, and human-centred manner. Through awareness-raising initiatives, training programmes, policy dialogues, and knowledge-sharing activities, UNESCO will support civil servants and public sector actors in building practical knowledge of AI applications, ethical considerations, risk mitigation measures, transparency requirements, and data governance principles. The activity will draw on UNESCO’s normative frameworks, tools, and global expertise, including the Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence, to promote the responsible use of emerging technologies in public service delivery, communication, and decision-making.
